info.textSample: Mamak menu Home About Menu show more Order Takeaway show more Order Delivery Gift Cards Shop Catering Careers Press Contact Mamak is an award winning Malaysian restaurant, with branches in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane. Named after the roadside stalls of Kuala Lumpur that peddle Indian Malay street food, Mamak is renowned for authentic, bold and traditional flavours, with smart and friendly service. Give the gift of a truly authentic Malaysian dining experience with our Gift Cards! Sambal & Satay Sauce jars back in stock at all branches and online store! Let us cater for your next function!
